query: SELECT tipo, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CAST(valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) as valor_total FROM accounts_receivable WHERE estado = 'EMITIDO' AND vencimentoData < CURDATE() AND (CAST(valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) > 0 GROUP BY tipo ORDER BY total DESC;
